 respondent/State.
 Order

This is repeat (second) bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in jail since 08.07.2025 in connection with Crime No.298 of 2023 registered at P.S. Harsood, District- Khandwa for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366 and 376(2)(n)
of IPC, Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO and Section 3(2)(va) of ST/SC Act.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits initially, applicant was released on bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 21.09.2023 passed in M.Cr.C.No.39506 of 2023.
But on 19.11.2024, applicant could not appear before trial Court, therefore, arrest warrant was issued.
Later-on, applicant surrendered before the trial Court on 08.07.2025 and has been in jail since then.

On above grounds, it is urged that applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37408 2 MCRC-33678-2025 be released on bail.
4.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
5. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
8. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to the applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
9. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
